capabilities: Indent the first line of body paragraphs in reading view with adjustable spacing and line height

Split

elements containing
into separate paragraphs via incremental DOM processing
Apply paper texture backgrounds to editing and reading views with adjustable opacity and dark mode
Customize grid background color, size, line width, and line style
Run commands to rescan paragraphs, toggle the splitter, and reset settings
extras: Detailed changelog documents fixes and known issues (splitter works only in reading view; dashed grid lines look poor at small sizes). Includes an explicitly experimental long-document scrolling performance option. MIT licensed.
problem:
Obsidian's reading view has no first-line paragraph indentation for East Asian typography, no way to split
-joined paragraphs for spacing, and no paper-like background textures.
summary:
Reading-view styling plugin that adds East Asian first-line paragraph indentation, a
paragraph splitter, and paper texture backgrounds.
